import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long FLOW_INF = 1_000_000_000_000_000_000L;
    static final int MAX = 150;
    
    static class FlowEdge {
        int v, u;
        long cap, flow;
        
        FlowEdge(int v, int u, long cap) {
            this.v = v;
            this.u = u;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = 0;
        }
    }
    
    static class Dinic {
        int n, m = 0;
        int s, t;
        List<FlowEdge> edges;
        List<List<Integer>> adj;
        int[] level;
        int[] ptr;
        Queue<Integer> q;
        
        Dinic(int n, int s, int t) {
            this.n = n;
            this.s = s;
            this.t = t;
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            level = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
            q = new LinkedList<>();
        }
        
        void add(int v, int u, long cap) {
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(v, u, cap));
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(u, v, 0));
            adj.get(v).add(m);
            adj.get(u).add(m + 1);
            m += 2;
        }
        
        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            level[s] = 0;
            q.offer(s);
            
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int viz : adj.get(v)) {
                    FlowEdge edge = edges.get(viz);
                    if (edge.cap - edge.flow < 1) continue;
                    if (level[edge.u] != -1) continue;
                    level[edge.u] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.offer(edge.u);
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }
        
        long dfs(int v, long pushed) {
            if (pushed == 0) return 0;
            if (v == t) return pushed;
            
            for (; ptr[v] < adj.get(v).size(); ptr[v]++) {
                int viz = adj.get(v).get(ptr[v]);
                FlowEdge edge = edges.get(viz);
                int u = edge.u;
                
                if (level[v] + 1 != level[u] || edge.cap - edge.flow < 1) continue;
                
                long tr = dfs(u, Math.min(pushed, edge.cap - edge.flow));
                if (tr == 0) continue;
                
                edge.flow += tr;
                edges.get(viz ^ 1).flow -= tr;
                return tr;
            }
            return 0;
        }
        
        long flow() {
            long f = 0;
            while (true) {
                if (!bfs()) break;
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                while (true) {
                    long pushed = dfs(s, FLOW_INF);
                    if (pushed == 0) break;
                    f += pushed;
                }
            }
            return f;
        }
    }
    
    static int[][] pos = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] matTempo = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] matAlc = new int[MAX][MAX];
    
    static List<int[]> pegaVizinhos(int i, int j, String[] mat, int n) {
        List<int[]> viz = new ArrayList<>();
        if (i + 1 < n) viz.add(new int[]{i+1, j});
        if (i - 1 >= 0) viz.add(new int[]{i-1, j});
        if (j + 1 < n) viz.add(new int[]{i, j+1});
        if (j - 1 >= 0) viz.add(new int[]{i, j-1});
        return viz;
    }
    
    static void criaMatTempo(int i, int j, String[] sc, int n, int currT) {
        if (i >= n || i < 0 || j >= n || j < 0 || (!Character.isDigit(sc[i].charAt(j)) && sc[i].charAt(j) != 'Z') || 
            (matTempo[i][j] != -1 && matTempo[i][j] <= currT)) return;
        
        if (matTempo[i][j] == -1) {
            matTempo[i][j] = currT;
        } else {
            matTempo[i][j] = Math.min(currT, matTempo[i][j]);
        }
        
        criaMatTempo(i+1, j, sc, n, currT+1);
        criaMatTempo(i-1, j, sc, n, currT+1);
        criaMatTempo(i, j+1, sc, n, currT+1);
        criaMatTempo(i, j-1, sc, n, currT+1);
    }
    
    static void criaMatAlc(int i, int j, String[] sc, int n, int currT) {
        if (i >= n || i < 0 || j >= n || j < 0 || (matAlc[i][j] != -1 && matAlc[i][j] <= currT) || 
            !Character.isDigit(sc[i].charAt(j))) return;
        
        if (matAlc[i][j] == -1) {
            matAlc[i][j] = currT;
        } else {
            matAlc[i][j] = Math.min(currT, matAlc[i][j]);
        }
        
        criaMatAlc(i+1, j, sc, n, currT+1);
        criaMatAlc(i-1, j, sc, n, currT+1);
        criaMatAlc(i, j+1, sc, n, currT+1);
        criaMatAlc(i, j-1, sc, n, currT+1);
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        int n2 = n * n;
        int nMax = n2 * 2;
        Dinic grafo = new Dinic(nMax + 2, 0, nMax + 1);
        String[] scArr = new String[n];
        String[] caps = new String[n];
        
        int cnt = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                pos[i][j] = cnt;
                cnt++;
            }
        }
        
        int iZ = -1, jZ = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            scArr[i] = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (scArr[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    iZ = i;
                    jZ = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            caps[i] = sc.next();
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(matTempo[i], -1);
        }
        criaMatTempo(iZ, jZ, scArr, n, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (matTempo[i][j] == -1 && Character.isDigit(scArr[i].charAt(j))) {
                    matTempo[i][j] = t;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < MAX; k++) {
                    Arrays.fill(matAlc[k], -1);
                }
                
                if (Character.isDigit(scArr[i].charAt(j))) {
                    int lmt = scArr[i].charAt(j) - '0';
                    grafo.add(0, pos[i][j], lmt);
                    criaMatAlc(i, j, scArr, n, 0);
                    
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                            if (matAlc[k][l] != -1 && matTempo[k][l] != -1 && 
                                matAlc[k][l] <= matTempo[k][l] && matAlc[k][l] <= t) {
                                boolean crt = true;
                                if (matAlc[k][l] == matTempo[k][l]) {
                                    crt = false;
                                    if (k+1 < n && matAlc[k+1][l] != -1 && matAlc[k+1][l] < matTempo[k+1][l]) crt = true;
                                    if (k-1 >= 0 && matAlc[k-1][l] != -1 && matAlc[k-1][l] < matTempo[k-1][l]) crt = true;
                                    if (l+1 < n && matAlc[k][l+1] != -1 && matAlc[k][l+1] < matTempo[k][l+1]) crt = true;
                                    if (l-1 >= 0 && matAlc[k][l-1] != -1 && matAlc[k][l-1] < matTempo[k][l-1]) crt = true;
                                }
                                if (crt) {
                                    grafo.add(pos[i][j], n2 + pos[k][l], lmt);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(caps[i].charAt(j))) {
                    grafo.add(n2 + pos[i][j], nMax + 1, caps[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        long ans = grafo.flow();
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
